title: I Unsubscribed from 150 Email Newsletters with Claude
description:
No need to sign up to Unroll or anything else, with Claude I was able to list all my newsletters and unsubscribe en masse.

To do this you need the Google Workspace CLI. I have another video on how to install this. 

How to install the Google Workspace CLI
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hxggsSm3Fis
